messages:
Hannah_Support: FYI customer Acme Analytics escalated — SDK estimator shows ~1.3k tokens, invoice shows ~29.8k for one chat session. They only sent a short prompt and uploaded a file. Need triage. :grimacing:
Dev_Raj: Can you paste the exact curl/SDK snippet and session id?
Hannah_Support: session id: sess_7X9a. Here's sanitized curl we received:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat'
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -F 'messages=[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Please summarize this file\"}]'
  -F 'file=@./data/report.bin'
```
Maya_Billing: Invoice shows 29,812 tokens at 2026-04-02 14:03 UTC. Billing flagged.
Dev_Raj: Two quick hypotheses: 1) server-side ingestion expands the binary into a long textual preview (base64/hex) that gets appended to the conversation and tokenized; 2) SDK estimator replaces the file with a short placeholder client-side and so undercounts. Any ingest logs?
ingest-service: ingest-service: detected tool call 'file_upload' in session sess_7X9a; multipart part size=1.8MB; extracted metadata fields: 42 keys; 'hex_dump' length ~= 98k chars.
Hannah_Support: Customer reiterates they only saw filename client-side (no preview).
Dev_Raj: Can you pull the server transcript for that session (sanitized)? Need to confirm whether a system message was injected.
Hannah_Support: Server transcript snippet (sanitized):
```json
{\"role\":\"system\",\"content\":\"file_preview:\nname: report.bin\nsize: 1892341\nheaders:\n  header1: AAAABBBBCCCC...\nhex_dump: 0f1e2d3c... (approx 98k chars)\"}
```
Maya_Billing: That hex_dump looks like the culprit — tokenizer would split that into ~28k tokens. SDK estimate is only counting the short placeholder '[file:report.bin]'.
Dev_Raj: Root cause hypothesis confirmed: ingestion pipeline extracts/serializes attachment metadata and appends it as a system message before tokenization. That causes server-side billable tokens to spike while client estimator remains small.
Hannah_Support: Customer requested refund/credit. Any short-term mitigation we can apply while ingestion is patched?
Maya_Billing: We can issue a one-time credit and open a dispute. I'll create a billing case. For broader mitigation: add a metering heuristic to ignore system messages matching 'file_preview' or any system message with length > 1k characters or containing 'hex_dump'.
Dev_Raj: I'll open GH issue rwd/ingest#1428 to: (a) stop injecting raw previews into chat content and store them as attachment blobs; (b) add sanitization to truncate or redact large binary dumps; (c) add a metering rule to skip these when computing tokens. ETA: triage tomorrow, aim for patch in 3 business days.
Dev_Raj: Repro we used locally (sanitized Node snippet):
```js
const FormData = require('form-data');
const fs = require('fs');
const form = new FormData();
form.append('messages', JSON.stringify([{role:'user', content:'Please summarize this file'}]));
form.append('file', fs.createReadStream('./data/report.bin'));
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token}, body: form});
```
Hannah_Support: Customer accepted a one-time credit for now. They asked for a postmortem and ETA for a permanent fix.
Maya_Billing: Billing dispute created: DISPUTE-9876. Finance and support notified.
Dev_Raj: Action items: @ingest-team: remove raw previews from chat payloads and store as metadata blobs; @metering-team: add ignore-rules for long system messages and explicit 'hex_dump' keys; @devex: update SDK docs to call out server-side expansions and that client-side estimator may undercount when server mutates messages. I'll draft an internal postmortem and a customer-facing follow-up.
Hannah_Support: Closing thread for now; will reopen if customer needs more detail.
